caption: POV: your reading nook needed this journal 🕯️
setting: Her lap under a plaid blanket on a rainy November evening, a brass lamp, fairy lights and a stack of old books softly out of focus.
person: Light-skinned hands with short glossy nude oval nails, two thin gold rings, cream chunky-knit sleeves over the wrists.

shots.action: Looking down at her lap, her fingers pull the velvet ribbon loose on the gift box.
Both hands lift the lid off and the kit is revealed in its tray.
Close on her hands lifting the notebook out and tilting it so the lamp light slides across the emblem.
She draws the tasselled bookmark out of the tray and lets the tassel swing.
She tears a strip of washi tape and presses it into the open notebook with a fingertip.
A wide look down at the open notebook with the whole kit arranged around it, one hand resting on the page.
